entities.summary: Evans Wadongo is a Kenyan engineer, a partner at Wadson Ventures, the co-founder of GreenWize Energy Ltd, the founder of SDFA-Kenya, and one of CNN's top ten heroes of 2010. He is a graduate in electronic and computer engineering from the Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology in Kenya.
